import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Fix text-formatted flipper lengths
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix text-formatted body mass (commas, written as text)
    if df['body_mass_g'].dtype == object:
        df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    else:
        df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Dram': 'Dream', 'Torgerson': 'Torgersen'})
    # Fix sex case variant
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().to_dict()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in result.items()}
